statements.title: BSR(m,3) = 2m for every m ≥ 2
statements.formal_part: partly: the lower bound 2m (Lemma 6, for the witness with slopes 0, …, m−1), the algebraic core of Lemma 2, and for the case e = 1 the second-variation identity in adapted coordinates and the trace contradiction under symmetry, L ⪰ 0, full support, rank ≤ a + 1 and a negative direction (L ⪰ 0 is equivalent to the second-order condition for every variation of the family); outside the formal part: the passage from a representation to the summands x₀ ⊗ y_j in adapted coordinates, Proposition 3, Lemma 5, the case e ≥ 2 and the assembly of the upper bound

fidelity.note: Por `second_variation_identity`, la desigualdad \(\sum_i H(D_i,D_i)\ge0\) para toda variación de la familia equivale a la propia hipótesis \(L\succeq0\), así que la cobertura fiel es «identidad de segunda variación en coordenadas adaptadas y contradicción de traza bajo simetría, \(L\succeq0\), soporte pleno, rango \(\le a+1\) y una dirección negativa».

statements.title: an integer point where the sum-of-2m-squares map is a submersion
statements.formal_part: the linear algebra: a Hankel multiplier vanishing on ker[I P Q] is zero (regular_point_hankel); the duality from there to «dΦ onto» is on paper

fidelity.note: Para todo \(m\ge2\), `regular_point_hankel` expresa que \(\ker[I\ P\ Q]\subseteq\ker H\) obliga a anular cada entrada de \(H\) en los índices del artículo, con el paso por dualidad expresamente fuera de la cobertura.

statements.title: a boundary point carries an indefinite Hankel multiplier with first and second order conditions
at such a point: independent summands, rank at most m, no simple tensor in the image
a multiplier without simple tensors has rank above its support
an explicit form that needs 2m squares
statements.formal_part: the witness with slopes 0, …, m−1 (F_wit): its 2m squares and the lower bound 2m; the paper’s F_m uses slopes 1, …, m, and the change y₂ ↦ y₂ − y₁ that carries one to the other (with the conservation of the SOS length) is not formalized

fidelity.note: Para las pendientes \(0,\ldots,m-1\), `wit3_sos` exhibe los \(2m\) cuadrados y `wit3_length` prueba que toda representación del mismo polinomio usa al menos \(2m\), con el cambio \(y_2\mapsto y_2-y_1\) al testigo del artículo expresamente fuera de la cobertura.

statements.title: width four: BSR(m,4) ≤ 3m, and 11 ≤ BSR(4,4) ≤ 12
statements.formal_part: the implication only: Theorem 1 enters as a hypothesis (bsr_width_four, bsr_upper_three), and Theorem 1 is itself only partly formalized; the comparison identity is fully formalized

fidelity.note: `bsr_width_four` deduce \(\mathrm{BSR}(m,4)\le3m\) de la hipótesis explícita \(\mathrm{BSR}(m,3)\le2m\), y `bssv_identity` prueba en \(\mathbb Z\) la identidad usada en ambas comparaciones.
